about: One row per public claim: wording, locations, evidence, exclusions and status. Wording rules per topic live in _claims.json; registry_ids point at them. Evidence pointers are repo-relative.

rows.wording: See, save, and steer any PyTorch model.
rows.models: tests/classics_corpus sample; Menagerie campaign outside this repo
rows.evidence_note: Architecture-general design with a tested classics sample; the limitations catalog names models and execution modes that refuse or are not verified.
rows.exclusions: TorchScript, torch.export, CUDA graph replay, GPTQ/AWQ packed weights, sharded FSDP/DTensor topologies (see the limitations catalog).

rows.wording: TorchLens captures every activation and gradient
rows.evidence_note: Operation-level capture within supported execution boundaries; fused kernels and opaque extensions are one op each, and backward capture is torch-only.
rows.exclusions: Fused kernels' internal tensors; opaque C++ extensions; non-torch backends record derived leaf-level gradients, not backward graphs.

rows.wording: Any architecture, even dynamic and recurrent ones.
rows.models: classics corpus recurrent and dynamic entries
rows.evidence_note: Dynamic control flow and recurrence are captured as executed (multi-pass ops); the classics corpus includes recurrent models.
rows.exclusions: Same as readme-any-pytorch-model.

rows.wording: 8,500+ catalog entries across ~3,600 architecture families, measured 2026-08-16
rows.evidence_note: Catalog size from the Model Menagerie project on 2026-08-16; the audited, deduplicated count by family and check is not on file in this repo.
rows.exclusions: Catalog entries are not all executed checks; structure-only entries are not verified captures.

rows.wording: 8,500+ rows across ~3,600 families in the menagerie catalog, measured 2026-08-16
rows.evidence_note: Same figure as readme-menagerie-catalog-count, second location.
rows.exclusions: As readme-menagerie-catalog-count.

rows.wording: Run across thousands of cataloged entries in the Model Menagerie
rows.evidence_note: Hedged count; no audited count in this repo.
rows.exclusions: As readme-menagerie-catalog-count.

rows.wording: verified on thousands of models across all major architecture families
rows.evidence_note: The verified count lives in the Menagerie project's append-only ledger, outside this repo; no release-matched count is on file here.
rows.exclusions: Unverified rows (huge models, hard dependencies, bespoke inputs) are excluded by definition.
rows.say_today: Architecture-general design, diverse real examples, Menagerie with hedged count
rows.before_strengthening: Audited, deduplicated counts by family, backend and check

rows.wording: faithful capture is proven, not assumed, for verified captures
rows.evidence_note: Replay plus metadata invariants per verified capture; replay success is not by itself proof that every operation was seen.
rows.exclusions: Fused and opaque boundaries; captures where validation is unavailable or refused.

rows.wording: 180+ metadata fields per operation
rows.evidence_note: No test pins the field counts; the figures were not re-counted for this ledger.

rows.wording: 550+ fields in total across every record type
rows.evidence_note: No test pins the field counts.

rows.wording: ## Validated across thousands of catalog entries
rows.evidence_note: Heading form of readme-verified-on-thousands.
rows.exclusions: As readme-verified-on-thousands.

rows.wording: Today the campaign has algorithmically verified thousands of models across all major architecture families
rows.evidence_note: Count kept in the Menagerie project; hedged in the README.
rows.exclusions: Unverified tail counted as unverified.

rows.wording: How it is verified
rows.evidence_note: Each supported-versions row is executed by a CI leg; the leg pins are kept in lockstep by tests/test_ci_packaging_gates.py.
rows.exclusions: macOS and Windows run only a nightly canary.

rows.evidence_note: Floor legs pin the exact floor pair per interpreter.

rows.wording: Policy: track the latest released transformers.
rows.evidence_note: 4.x and 5.x bands run in CI; 5.x support statements wait for the 5.18 leg (copy guard forks.4).
rows.exclusions: Op-count goldens recorded on 5.x are deselected on 4.x legs.

rows.wording: Index any operation by name, module path, or ordinal
rows.evidence_note: The README quickstart block is executed by the README gate.
rows.exclusions: Ambiguous keys refuse with AmbiguousOpLookupError (for example a module with two output ops).

rows.wording: measured at 0.84x raw on ResNet-18 and 0.83x on GPT-2 (HookedTransformer) at 25% depth
rows.evidence_note: Measured 2026-05-14 on CPU for the halt-at-25%-depth case only; configuration-specific and older than v2.36.1. Rerun on the release before quoting.
rows.exclusions: Only the early-halt case; full capture is slower than the raw forward.
rows.say_today: Bound live edits at hook speed
rows.before_strengthening: Refreshed matched measurements before quoting older ratios

rows.wording: Full exhaustive capture runs at roughly 14x the raw forward
rows.evidence_note: Single multiplier from the 2026-05-14 table; the per-model table varies widely (for example gpt2_hf cuda global_wrap_dummy 112x).
rows.exclusions: Model- and device-specific.

rows.wording: The first tool that gets ResNets right
rows.evidence_note: Correctness on ResNet skip connections is tested; the comparative 'first tool' part has no dated survey on file.
rows.exclusions: Uniqueness claim needs a dated peer survey (cross-cutting rule in _claims.json).

rows.wording: Every geometric claim is verification-backed, not asserted
rows.evidence_note: rf.check and the receptive-field validate scope are tested against autograd support.
rows.exclusions: Possible dependence is not observed causal effect.

rows.wording: No other extraction tool ships a receptive-field subsystem with this verification loop.
rows.evidence_note: No dated peer survey on file.

rows.wording: Every operation records shape, dtype, device, timing, FLOPs
rows.evidence_note: Per-op metadata fields are covered by the metadata tests.
rows.exclusions: FLOPs are formula-exact only for ops with a known rule; unknown ops are disclosed.

rows.wording: Every op also records the Python call stack that produced it
TorchLens visualizes any architecture -- no matter how exotic.
rows.evidence_note: Rendering covers captured graphs; very large graphs fall back to layout limits.
rows.exclusions: Models that cannot be captured cannot be drawn.

rows.wording: Thousands of them currently carry the replay-and-invariant verification described above.
rows.evidence_note: As readme-verified-on-thousands.

rows.wording: the interior is fully logged with full verified semantics
rows.evidence_note: torch >= 2.6 force_eager stance during capture.
rows.exclusions: torch below 2.6 bypasses dynamo regions with capture_verified=False.

rows.wording: It is read through a restricted, default-deny unpickler
rows.exclusions: Running a runnable artifact or trusting custom callables is code execution.

rows.exclusions: Preview save= filters exposure, not capture (no memory reduction); derived gradients are not recorded backward passes.

rows.wording: TorchLens helps coding agents implement interpretability methods
rows.evidence_note: A small docs-use study exists; the agent benchmark (pilot and confirmation) has not run.
rows.exclusions: No agent productivity claim anywhere until the benchmark numbers exist.

rows.wording: IOI circuit by EAP-IG at head ROC AUC 0.926 on GPT-2 small
rows.evidence_note: Measured on the batch-2 train: head ROC AUC 0.9263 against the 26 Wang circuit heads, 1000 MIB IOI train rows, EAP-IG m=5. Not yet rerun on a release.
rows.exclusions: Edge recall at k=182 was 0.3956.

rows.wording: Attribution graph matches circuit-tracer on Gemma-2 2B within 8.6e-7 of the largest adjacency entry
rows.evidence_note: Measured on the batch-2 train: largest adjacency difference 8.64e-7 of the largest oracle entry, relative Frobenius 1.10e-6, CPU float32, Dallas prompt, 9,170 features. The 1.05e-6 figure in the launch plan is the spread between two circuit-tracer environments, not the TorchLens agreement.
rows.exclusions: One prompt; CPU float32.

rows.wording: TorchLens activations scored on Brain-Score benchmarks end to end
rows.evidence_note: Measured 2026-10-14: MajajHong2015public.IT-pls 0.4408, Geirhos2021colour-top1 0.9547; seam parity max abs diff 0.0 against Brain-Score's PytorchWrapper on 24 stimuli.
rows.exclusions: Brain-Score is a destination: never 'runs Brain-Score' or RSA parity wording (U28.4).
